embeds.title: ARTICLE XI — FUTURE DRAFT PICKS AND PREPAYMENT
embeds.description:
Draft-pick trading is enabled for the **current annual draft plus the next three annual drafts**. Five rounds of annual draft picks are tradeable.

**Conditional draft picks are prohibited.**

A franchise trading a future **1st- or 2nd-round pick** must be prepaid through the season associated with that pick.

Trading future **3rd-, 4th-, or 5th-round picks** does not trigger additional prepayment beyond the league’s ordinary prepaid requirement.

Current-season FAAB may be traded. **Future-season FAAB may not be traded.**
